mapper.sql: S.SCHD_ID, S.SCHD_CLSF_CD, S.SCHD_NM, S.SCHD_DETAIL_CN, S.BEGIN_DT, S.END_DT, S.SCHD_WRTR_ID, S.SCHD_REGST_DT, S.SCHD_CHGR_ID, S.SCHD_CHG_DT, S.ALL_DAY_YN, S.DEL_YN, S.DEL_DT, S.REPT_YN, S.REPT_TYPE_CD, S.REPT_END_DT, WE.EMP_NM AS SCHD_WRTR_NM, WD.DEPT_NM AS SCHD_WRTR_DEPT_NM, WJG.JOB_GRD_NM AS SCHD_WRTR_JOB_GRD_NM, WE.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID AS SCHD_WRTR_PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID, (SELECT TO_NUMBER(ST.TARGET_ID) FROM TB_SCHD_TARGET ST WHERE ST.SCHD_ID = S.SCHD_ID AND ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '06' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS TASK_ID, (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SCHD_TARGET ST WHERE ST.SCHD_ID = S.SCHD_ID AND ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '05' ) THEN ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(ST.TARGET_ID) FROM TB_SCHD_TARGET ST WHERE ST.SCHD_ID = S.SCHD_ID AND ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '05' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SCHD_TARGET ST WHERE ST.SCHD_ID = S.SCHD_ID AND ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '06' ) THEN ( SELECT T.PROJ_ID FROM TB_TASK T INNER JOIN TB_SCHD_TARGET ST ON TO_CHAR(T.TASK_ID) = ST.TARGET_ID WHERE ST.SCHD_ID = S.SCHD_ID AND ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '06' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) ELSE NULL END FROM DUAL) AS PROJ_ID, (SELECT TO_NUMBER(ST.TARGET_ID) FROM TB_SCHD_TARGET ST WHERE ST.SCHD_ID = S.SCHD_ID AND ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '07' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS MTNG_ID, (SELECT TO_NUMBER(ST.TARGET_ID) FROM TB_SCHD_TARGET ST WHERE ST.SCHD_ID = S.SCHD_ID AND ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '08' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS RSRV_ID, (SELECT D.DEPT_NM FROM TB_DEPARTMENT D WHERE D.DEPT_CD = ( SELECT ST.TARGET_ID FROM TB_SCHD_TARGET ST WHERE ST.SCHD_ID = S.SCHD_ID AND ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '04' AND ROWNUM = 1 )) AS SCHD_DEPT_NM
mapper.select:
SELECT
, T.TARGET_TYPE_CD , T.TARGET_ID FROM TB_INTG_SCHD S LEFT JOIN TB_SCHD_TARGET T ON S.SCHD_ID = T.SCHD_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE WE ON WE.EMP_ID = S.SCHD_WRTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT WD ON WD.DEPT_CD = WE.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE WJG ON WJG.JOB_GRD_CD = WE.JOB_GRD_CD WHERE AND S.SCHD_ID = #{schdId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SCHD_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_INTG_SCHD ( SCHD_ID, SCHD_CLSF_CD, SCHD_NM, SCHD_DETAIL_CN, BEGIN_DT, END_DT, SCHD_WRTR_ID, SCHD_REGST_DT, ALL_DAY_YN, DEL_YN, REPT_YN, REPT_TYPE_CD, REPT_END_DT ) VALUES ( #{schdId}, #{schdClsfCd}, #{schdNm}, #{schdDetailCn}, #{beginDt}, #{endDt}, #{schdWrtrId}, SYSDATE, #{allDayYn}, 'N', #{reptYn}, #{reptTypeCd}, #{reptEndDt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_INTG_SCHD SET SCHD_CLSF_CD = #{schdClsfCd}, SCHD_NM = #{schdNm}, SCHD_DETAIL_CN = #{schdDetailCn}, BEGIN_DT = #{beginDt}, END_DT = #{endDt}, ALL_DAY_YN = #{allDayYn}, REPT_YN = #{reptYn}, REPT_TYPE_CD = #{reptTypeCd}, REPT_END_DT = #{reptEndDt}, SCHD_CHGR_ID = #{schdChgrId}, SCHD_CHG_DT = SYSDATE WHERE SCHD_ID = #{schdId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.delete: UPDATE TB_INTG_SCHD SET DEL_YN = 'Y', DEL_DT = SYSDATE, SCHD_CHGR_ID = #{schdId}, SCHD_CHG_DT = SYSDATE WHERE SCHD_ID = #{schdId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT S.SCHD_ID AS id, S.SCHD_CLSF_CD AS scheduleTypeCode, S.SCHD_NM AS title, S.BEGIN_DT AS startDt, S.END_DT AS endDt, S.ALL_DAY_YN AS allDayYn, NULL AS deptNm, NULL AS projNm, NULL AS taskNm FROM TB_INTG_SCHD S WHERE S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.SCHD_CLSF_CD IN ('C001', 'C003') AND S.END_DT >= #{beginDt} ORDER BY S.BEGIN_DT ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
